# Vision Zero DC

> Public-interest tool that reads official Washington, DC open crash data to show where people are killed or seriously injured on DC streets, who is hurt, and which evidence-backed interventions are best supported. Static site; every number traces to a primary source.

The site has five pages — a Safety Overview (insights + recommendations), an interactive Crash Map, a High-Injury Corridors (Hotspots) view, an ANC Safety Brief builder, and a Safe Streets Law Tracker — backed by baked JSON generated from Open Data DC plus curated source-linked policy data. Editorial rule: separate observed facts from estimates and judgments; recommendations are transparent evidence cards, never opaque "safety scores." KSI = people Killed or Seriously (major) Injured.

## Pages

- [Safety Overview](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/index.html): accountability scorecard (deaths & serious injuries vs. a settled baseline, honest about the missed 2024 target and preliminary recent years), multi-year deaths-vs-injuries trend, who-is-hurt by travel mode, the "where harm concentrates" headline, and evidence-backed policy recommendations.
- [Crash Map](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/map.html): interactive Leaflet map of geocoded police-reported crashes with date / severity / mode / KSI-only filters, hot spots, ward crash rates with denominators, a moving-violations overlay, and per-crash case files. Filters and map view are URL-shareable.
- [Hotspots](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/hotspots.html): the highest-injury corridors as an interactive Leaflet map plus profile cards (severity, mode breakdown, recommended interventions, equity notes, confidence). Per-corridor counts are real — computed by joining Open Data DC crash records to the DDOT High Injury Network (crashes within 25 m of the corridor centerline, 2022-present); KSI = people killed or seriously (major) injured.
- [For ANCs](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/anc.html): community-led prioritization tool. Pick a ward to see its crash burden, the high-injury corridors that run through it, and ward-scoped + citywide evidence-backed recommendations, then generate an editable, source-grounded resolution draft to bring to an Advisory Neighborhood Commission (copy or open in email; nothing is sent automatically). Deep-linkable via `#ward-N`.
- [Laws](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/laws.html): source-linked tracker for enacted DC safe-streets laws and codified funds. It states what the law text requires and points to delivery audits; it does not claim agency compliance without separate primary records.

## Data (baked, machine-readable JSON)

- [crash-summary.json](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/data/crash-summary.json): per-ward and per-year crash totals, KSI, severity-weighted triage score, exposure rates (per 100k residents and per sq mi), an accountability `scorecard`, and per-mode KSI — with full provenance and caveats. The canonical numeric source for the site.
- [ward-denominators.json](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/data/ward-denominators.json): ward population used as a rate denominator — ≈2022 ward-level estimates on the 2022 ward boundaries, anchored to the 2020 U.S. Census total (689,545); per-ward values are a secondary compilation pending reconfirmation against DC Office of Planning tables.
- [hin-corridors.json](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/data/hin-corridors.json): all 77 DDOT High Injury Network corridors with real crash/injury/KSI/fatality counts and per-mode KSI, from a crashes↔HIN spatial join (2022-present, 25 m buffer). Backs the Hotspots map (top corridors) and the per-ward corridor lists.
- [countermeasures.json](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/data/countermeasures.json): proven traffic-safety interventions with cited crash-reduction effect sizes (flagged unverified until checked against the primary source).
- [recommendations.json](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/data/recommendations.json): evidence-card recommendations (problem, location, evidence + sources, mechanism, equity check, confidence, uncertainty).
- [legislation.json](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/data/legislation.json): verified D.C. Law Library inventory for enacted street-safety laws, requirements, caveats, and delivery-audit pointers.

## Documentation

- [README](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/README.md): how to run locally, the data pipeline, the pages, and the tests.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/CLAUDE.md): project intent, the editorial promise, data principles, and recommendation rules.
- [AGENTS.md](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/AGENTS.md): operating manual for AI agents, including token and web-search discipline.
- [DESIGN.md](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/DESIGN.md): the visual and UX system.
- [BACKLOG.md](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/BACKLOG.md): roadmap, peer-city research, and shipped items.

## Authoritative sources

- [Open Data DC — Crashes in DC](https://opendata.dc.gov/datasets/DCGIS::crashes-in-dc): the underlying crash dataset.
- [DDOT Vision Zero](https://visionzero.dc.gov/): DC's official Vision Zero program and curated figures.
- [DC Vision Zero crash dashboard](https://dcvisionzero.github.io/Crash-Injury-Dashboard/): DDOT's interactive crash/injury dashboard.
- [D.C. Law Library](https://code.dccouncil.gov/): primary source for enacted DC laws and codified traffic-safety funds.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/llms-full.txt): fuller context — data dictionary, methodology, and caveats in one file.
- [pipeline/snapshot.py](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/pipeline/snapshot.py): regenerates crash-summary.json from the live ArcGIS endpoints.
- [pipeline/hotspots.py](https://pranava0x0.github.io/VisionZeroDC/pipeline/hotspots.py): regenerates hin-corridors.json and hotspots.geojson by joining crashes to the DDOT High Injury Network. A weekly GitHub Action reruns both pipelines and opens a data-refresh PR.
